project.description: The FSPIOP "Transaction" data model (Mojaloop FSP Interoperability API v1.1) that PH-EE's Mojaloop connector puts in ILP packets, written by DIFME from the open API specification. It takes the place of org.mifos:interop-ilp-conditions, whose licence ("All Rights Reserved. Distribution, reproduction or use is prohibited without permission") is not open source. Same package name, so the vendored connector compiles unchanged. Interledger codecs come from the vendored java-ilp-core (Apache-2.0).
